scope: Local policy over verified projections. Context and route are never transmitted.
validation: Unknown keys, explicit null optional members, booleans used as numbers, nonfinite numbers, out-of-range coordinates and bounds are invalidConfiguration. Context may be null or empty. Every supplied member is validated before fallback. Adjacent route vertices with dot <= -1 + 1e-12 are invalid. Repeated identical vertices are allowed.
gps: Structurally valid fixes with accuracy >1000m or age outside 0..300000ms are unavailable. Explicit manual area and route each work without GPS. Future fixes are unavailable, allowing caller clock rollback to be handled without inferred location.
geometry: Minimum distance to closed minor great-circle arcs on a sphere. One route point acts as a circle. Manual area, usable GPS area and route are combined by union. Report signed accuracy never widens the area or corridor.
expiry: expires_at_ms <= now_ms is expired. now_ms is a nonnegative safe integer. Repository clock/quarantine/admission checks precede policy.
selection: Eligible only, observed_at_ms descending then ID ascending, deduplicated immutable IDs. Selection input must already be admitted. This ordering is local only.
wire_inventory: Existing exchange-v1 ID ascending order, including across bounded raw candidate pages. Relevance filters each <=8 raw candidate page and is rechecked on load. Preserve the raw cursor through empty filtered pages. Freeze context per encounter.
report_page: Inspect <=64 raw rows plus lookahead, observed_at_ms DESC then ID ASC. Typed cursor advances by inspected rows. Empty filtered pages may have more rows. Recheck original signed bytes and preserve history/query bounds.
